# Africa Royal Tours — Travel Atelier

> Private, tailor-made African journeys with personal advice from a Travel Atelier Advisor.
> This US English mirror includes 50 published trip ideas, not binding package travel offers.

## Important limitations
These trip ideas are inspiration, not binding package travel offers. Services, contracting parties, availability, and contractual arrangements are specified transparently in each individual proposal.
Prices and budgets remain in euros (EUR); no US dollar conversion or availability is implied.
German-speaking guides described in the itineraries remain German-speaking; English-language guiding must be confirmed.
Legal and privacy notices on this prototype remain placeholders requiring review before launch.
Source trip data: ../data/reisen.json. German counterparts are linked on every English page.
